limits: File scope is only the supplied directory or ZIP.
No application, visual, decryption or full disaster recovery validation.
PDF comparison covers extracted text, not visual, image or hyperlink equivalence.

pdf_content_comparison.method: NFC and Unicode whitespace normalization; case, accents, digits and punctuation preserved; ordered token diff
excluded: verified site header and article title
limits: Differences are not automatically accepted as layout-only.
No visual, image, hyperlink destination or formula rendering equivalence is asserted.
Token equality ignores whitespace placement around punctuation; exact whitespace-normalized equality is also reported.
